title: Customer names still show on work orders and invoices even when Customers is hidden
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View OFF, Work orders View ON, Invoicing & payments View ON and See Financial Data ON.
steps:
1. Log in and confirm Customers is not in the top navigation.
  2. Open Work Orders and open a work order for a known customer.
  3. Look at the work order header for the customer name.
  4. Open the invoice for that work order.
  5. Look at the customer name on the invoice.
expected:
The customer name shows on the work order header.

The customer name shows on the invoice.

The customer's own page cannot be opened, but customer names still appear on records the user can see.
